note: Christmas Island is served by Westpac's branch there, and Westpac's Australian cards: its Low Rate card costs 7 dollars a month, with a variable purchase rate of 13.74% a year (Westpac says it is changing the card's fees and rates on 30 November 2026). The first-year fee waiver for existing customers is introductory and not written.
